rows.grounds: repeated relative adverb indicating distributive locations
compound denoting the axle bearing the load
fused form of saṃyogaḥ and tatra; internal sandhi noted, not split
passive verb expressing what is declared

items.question: At which locations does the joining with the load-axle occur?
premises: The load-axle is present at various locations.
Each such location is indicated distributively.
A joining is stated to occur at that location.
items.inference: Therefore the joining with the load-axle occurs wherever the load-axle is present.
uncertainties: The precise technical referent of bhārākṣaṃ in this context is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: Wherever the load-axle is found, there the joining is said to occur.
